_comment: D-03 boundary specimen (plan 04-03, Task 3). Ordinary, unremarkable local dev-tooling MCP setup: several servers, installed the way 04-RESEARCH.md §Q2 measured is common rather than exceptional (an unpinned package-runner argument -- `npx -y <pkg>`, `uvx <pkg>` -- with no version pin). D-03 puts an unpinned-install signal in a MEDIUM severity band deliberately, below the HIGH bar install-hook blocks commits at -- but MEDIUM is not permission to fire on this file, since the clean-corpus gate counts a finding at ANY severity. Several servers exist here so a config-hygiene pattern cannot pass by being narrow enough to miss one arrangement, and one server carries a TLS (https://) endpoint so the transport arm (a future http:// non-TLS pattern) has a legitimate neighbour to distinguish itself from.
